descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Consultanță și servicii de afaceri
As the Billing Manager, you will lead and guide our team of billing specialists towards achieving success and ensure the seamless operation of our billing processes. You will also serve as the vital bridge between our company and the diverse medical insurance providers in the United States.
 What you'll do 
Identifies and evaluates opportunities for process improvement within the billing department
Sets objectives and goals for the billing department
Leads the implementation of strategic changes to enhance efficiency
Monitors team performance and progress towards the set objectives
Provides coaching and mentorship to billing specialists
Coordinates employee performance appraisals and provides feedback
Recruits, hires, and trains new members of the billing team
Assigns and delegates tasks and projects to team members
Addresses and resolves escalated billing issues and disputes
Handles complex billing cases hands-on, ensuring resolution
Acts as the subject matter expert on all billing-related issues
Gathers data and generates performance reports
Presents performance reports to the C-level team
Actively participates in meetings with customers, collaborators, and suppliers
Ensures compliance with industry regulations and internal policies
Collaborates with other departments to streamline billing processes
Manages relationships with external vendors and service providers
 What we're looking for 
Minimum 2 years experience in a people management role, overseeing 10+ direct reports
Minimum 2 years billing experience in a supervisory role
Relevant customer service experience
Strong understanding of key business concepts
Proven track record in developing strategic business plans
Great data analysis skills
Experience in presenting reports to C-level executives
Proficiency in using billing software, databases and other relevant tools
Exceptional skills in Excel, Google Sheets, and similar applications for data analysis and reporting
Hands-on experience with CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce or Pipedrive
Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written — mandatory
 Nice to have 
Understanding of the medical insurance policies in the United States
 Who you are 
Excellent leadership skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Entrepreneurial mindset
Strategic thinker
Results-driven
Proactive attitude
Customer-centric approach
Strong attention to detail
Logical thinker with strong analytical skills
Flexible and adaptable, able to thrive in a fast-paced work environment
Resilient to stress
 What we offer 
Competitive salary
Private medical insurance
Professional development opportunities
Team building events
Young and dynamic team — we celebrate diversity and believe in the power of different voices coming together to drive innovation
